name: European Coal and Steel Community (12 stars, 1986–2002)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over black with twelve white five-pointed stars, six on each stripe.
history: The final ECSC flag, with twelve stars after the accession of Spain and Portugal on 1 January 1986; the number was then fixed at twelve regardless of later enlargements, like the European flag. It was lowered for the last time when the Treaty of Paris expired on 23 July 2002 and the Community was merged into the European Union.
